proposals.evidence: DEDR 2023 gives Tamil kai, Kannada kay/kayi/key, Toda koy, Kolami kī/key, Gadaba ki/kiy, Konda kiyu and Telugu ceyi/ceyyi ‘hand, arm’. Only simple hand/arm forms are assigned; compounds for palm, elbow or particular sides remain separate. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
